english.title: Fail to comply with condition of consent to beam etc being fixed or placed over highway
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), consent having been given under section 178 of the Highways Act 1980 for the fixing or placing of

(A)_[an overhead beam]_
(B)_[a rail]_
(C)_[a pipe]_
(D)_[a cable]_
(E)_[a wire]_
(F)_[apparatus, namely **(..SPECIFY APPARATUS..),]_(G)_[over]_
(H)_[along]_
(I)_[across]_

a highway at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..) by **(..SPECIFY HIGHWAY AUTHORITY..), the Highway authority for that highway, failed to comply with the terms and conditions of that consent in that **(..SPECIFY FAILURE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 178(4) of the Highways Act 1980.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
consent having been given under section 178
for the fixing or placing of an overhead beam/rail/pipe/cable/wire or other apparatus
over/along or across a highway
failed to comply with the terms and conditions of that consent

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Proceedings for this offence shall not without the written consent of the Attorney General, be taken by any person other than the person aggrieved, or a highway authority or council having an interest in the enforcement of the provision or byelaws in question - section 312 Highways Act 1980.
(ii) The meaning of "highway" is defined in section 328 Highways Act 1980.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level one on the standard scale. and if the offence is continued after conviction, he is guilty of a further offence and liable to a fine not exceeding £1 for each day on which the offence is so continued

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
